candidates.title: Redesign Pet Selection Grid with Animated Previews
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into an interactive stage layout with animated pet previews and sound effects so users can sample pets before committing.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a median time of 89s, showing users hesitate or get stuck when selecting their pet.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pick a friend screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses the most users (39.1%), but complex UI redesign with animations requires a full release.

decisions.title: Defer Account Sign-In After Pet Selection
Redesign Home Intro with Interactive Desktop Checklist

lessons_next: Deferring account sign-in after pet selection significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), making the predicted +15.0% gain far too high.
Redesigning the home intro with an interactive checklist showed no clear effect, so the +10.0% prediction was too high.
Spotlight layout changes for path selection yielded no clear effect, and the +8.0% prediction was too high.
Adding desktop overlay hints resulted in no clear effect, with predictions (+5.0%) being too high.
Predictions were consistently too high across all onboarding A/B tests.
